Hi Sam —

Great to meet you on the call today. Quick recap and suggested next steps so we stay aligned: 

1) Use case: NovaAI will use Redwood to serve your summarization + search rerank pipelines for customer-facing insights. Low latency is important for the UI (p95 target ~250ms).

2) Workload shape (from call): primarily short prompts with medium generation (avg 150 tokens), plus embedding workloads for vector search. You mentioned a pilot followed by production scale.

3) Pricing / volume questions I flagged on the call — can you confirm:
   - Expected billable tokens per month (pilot -> steady state)
   - Target budget range (monthly) you have in mind for the first 6–12 months
   - If you’re evaluating a target $/1M tokens for planning (helpful to know a target range)

4) Discounts asked: you mentioned the startup program and interest in a 12-month committed-use discount / multi-year incentives — we can outline options once we have volume/budget clarity.

Attached: Redwood_Startup_Program_Terms.pdf (summary) and a one-page mutual_action_plan.xlsx I’ll update with dates.

Proposed next step: 30-minute follow-up with Aditya (pricing) this week so we can align on committed tiers and calculate committed vs pay-as-you-go unit economics. Are you available Monday or Tuesday?

Thanks — we’ll tailor the numbers to match NovaAI’s expected volumes.

Best,

Thanks Marissa — helpful recap. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Pilot (months 1–3): expect ~80–120M billable tokens/month while we tune prompts and caching.
- Steady state (months 4+): planning for 150–200M tokens/month; monthly peak could spike to ~250M.
- Budget: we’re targeting $5k–$8k/month for the pilot phase and willing to expand to ~$15k–$20k/month if unit economics justify it in steady state.
- Target unit economics: ideally we’d like to see pricing in the ballpark of $1,000–$1,200 per 1M tokens (after any startup/committed discounts) to make the unit economics work for our pricing model.

Question: how does Redwood handle caching/prefix reuse — can that materially reduce billable tokens for us? Also curious about any minimum committed tiers for the 12-month commitment.

I can do Monday 11am PT for the follow-up with Aditya.

High-level on discounts (we’ll go deeper on the call):
- Startup program: one-time eligibility for early-stage companies (criteria attached). Typical starter benefit = 30% off list for 12 months + waived onboarding credits for pilots.
- Committed-use (12 months): we can offer tiered committed discounts — e.g., 40% off list for a 12-month committed spend of $X/month (we’ll map to tokens on the call).
- Multi-year: additional 5–10% incentive for multi-year commitments (or increased consumption guarantees).

We’ll build a quick committed vs pay-as-you-go calculator during the call so you can see the effective $/1M tokens at your expected volumes and how caching/prefix reuse impacts billable tokens.

I’ve attached the startup program terms and a draft mutual action plan; I’ll update the MAP live in the call and then send a DocuSign for the chosen option.

See you Monday at 11 — calendar invite sent.

Marissa

From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>

Subject: NovaAI — committed-use economics & rough calculator

Hi Sam — following up with the numbers we promised to walk through. Below is a quick, conservative model so you can see how committed tiers map to effective $/1M tokens. This is intentionally simple — we’ll finalize in the MAP.

Assumptions:
- List price (baseline) for your selected model: $2,000 per 1M tokens (example list for the model class discussed).
- Caching / reuse estimate: ~20% reduction in billable tokens (could be higher depending on prompt patterns).

Tier examples (effective $/1M tokens after discount):
- Pay-as-you-go (no commitment): list $2,000 -> effective $2,000/1M
- Startup program (30% off first 12 months): $1,400/1M
- 12-month committed use (40% off): $1,200/1M
- 12-month committed + startup eligibility (if allowed): could be structured to land ~ $840–1,000/1M for year 1 depending on overlap rules
- Multi-year add-on (additional 10%): e.g., $1,080/1M -> $972/1M after multi-year incentive

Illustrative monthly spend (150M tokens/month baseline, pre-cache):
- Pay-as-you-go: 150 * $2,000 / 1M = $300,000 (obviously not aligned with your budget — demonstrates power of discounts and caching)
- With 20% caching -> billable 120M tokens -> pay-as-you-go = $240,000
- Startup (30% off) + caching -> 120M * $1,400 / 1M = $168,000
- 12-month committed (40% off) + caching -> 120M * $1,200 / 1M = $144,000

Notes: the example list numbers above are to show relative impact of discounts; actual list price depends on model family and sequence-length profile. For NovaAI’s anticipated $5k–$20k/month budget range, we should model a smaller production footprint (and potentially incremental bursts). Committed discounts are typically structured against a committed $/month or committed total for the term, and we can size a pilot-friendly commit.

Next steps: I’ll prepare a short spreadsheet that maps your 3 volume scenarios (pilot / steady / peak) to committed tiers and monthly cost. We can surface a DocuSign ready for your legal once you pick the preferred structure (startup + 12mo commit or 12mo commit alone).

—Aditya
